payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all nine 2x2 sub-squares, counts black and white cells; if any has 4 same or 3-1 split, then possible with at most one repaint.
payload.rationale: The solution is an exhaustive search over all 2x2 sub-squares, not using branching, bounding, backtracking, bitmasks, or graph traversal. Among given subtypes, branch_and_bound is chosen as the top rule, though it only trivially breaks early after finding a valid square.
